name: D1 Hoops Power Rating
method: Ridge-regularised additive opponent adjustment (offence, defence, tempo) with conference-mean priors, jointly estimated home edge, pooled non-D-I node, and walk-forward out-of-sample predictions.

backtest.description: Out-of-sample: every prediction uses only games completed before that game's date (Eastern time). D-I vs D-I games only.
backtest.seasonedRule: Both teams had at least 3 prior weighted D-I games
